author: MarcusLammers
description:
Vast.ai RTX 3090 Spot Market, February-August 2026
	

Panel data from the vast.ai GPU rental marketplace, restricted to NVIDIA RTX 3090 offers. The public offer listing was polled every 10 minutes between 2026-02-13 and 2026-08-15. Each observation records price, hardware specifications, host reliability, and location. A derived lifecycle table gives the listing duration of every offer. Vast.ai does not publish historical listing data; this dataset was collected independently.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MarcusLammers/vast-rtx3090-market-6mo.
